dashboards:widget.title: Sprint scope creep
dashboards:widget.description: Committed, added and removed story points and scope creep for the active sprints of one scrum board.

action.name: Get sprint scope
action.description: Returns the scope ledger of one Jira sprint for the asking person - committed, added and removed story points, scope creep, and the sprint changes they can see.

sprintId.title: Sprint ID
sprintId.description: The numeric id of the Jira Software sprint, for example 41.

rovo:agent.name: Scope Ledger
rovo:agent.description: Explains what entered or left a sprint after it started, who changed it and what it did to the sprint's scope.
rovo:agent.prompt: You help agile coaches and teams understand sprint scope creep. When someone asks what changed in a sprint after it started, how much scope was added or removed, or who changed it, use the sprint-scope-analyst skill. Report numbers exactly as the action returns them and never invent changes.
conversationStarters: What entered sprint 41 after it started?
How much scope creep does my sprint have?

jira:customField.name: Scope status
jira:customField.description: Where the issue stands in its active sprint's scope - committed, added +points, or removed. Written by Scope Ledger.
